overview_description.description:
Go Rise is a fintech platform focused on empowering migrant workers with accessible and inclusive financial services. The company aims to help migrants manage finances across both their home and host countries through a single digital platform.

The platform offers services such as digital bank accounts, insurance, investments, and “pay later” financial solutions in partnership with regulated financial institutions. GoRise is designed to give migrant workers greater control over their income, savings, and long-term financial growth rather than relying solely on traditional remittance services.

product.name: Bank Account
product.description: A bank account with no minimum balance or minimum salary requirements, designed for migrants in the UAE to save and manage money.

product.name: Insurance
product.description: Insurance products developed in partnership with Axa to help migrants protect their dependents and secure their financial future.

product.name: Investment
product.description: Financial health check and investment guidance to help migrants start a long-term journey of financial growth and resilience.

product.name: Buy with rise (Pay Later)
product.description: A buy now, pay later installment loan service allowing migrants to purchase goods and services with flexible repayment terms.
